◈ THE WAR PATH — Footage plays. The galaxy has already watched these fights twice. The System narrates anyway — it likes the sound of its own broadcast voice. THE HERALD came. Named and located — the war council knew its face. They faced Big-Eyes and lived to sit here. They faced Ugly-Eyes and lived to sit here. 3 more of the later drafts faced besides. Even now the wave-4 bar reads: blood your fighters (0 of 1 veterans). Even now the wave-5 bar reads: blood your fighters (0 of 2 veterans).
